FN-L55T1AY-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 213
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Jack W. Williams
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/22/2025
Senate Bill 213 as introduced would decrease receipts annually to the Education Trust Fund,
beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of
energy used or consumed in poultry houses currently, which would now be exempt from the
utility gross receipts tax and the utility service use tax.

FN-L55T1AY-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 213
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Jack W. Williams
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/23/2025
Senate Bill 213 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education would
decrease receipts annually to the Education Trust Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of energy used or consumed in poultry houses
currently, which would now be exempt from the utility gross receipts tax and the utility service
use tax.
